sections.title: Unit 20: Water Management, Drought Crises & Wetland Restoration
body: Water is the defining strategic resource of the 21st century. While Hungary once prided itself on being a nation of waters ('a vizek országa'), misdirected hydro-engineering, severe climate droughts, and rampant industrial demand—such as battery gigafactories—have exposed profound vulnerabilities.
In this unit, you will master the elevated discourse of statutory conservation mandates, systemic threat framing, climate correlatives, and policy synthesis in Hungarian environmental politics.
